facts: Repository read access does not prove canonical tool execution.
GitHub direct mutation availability does not satisfy GitMutationPlan execution.
A provider gap must not degrade to Contents API writes or prompt-local planner reconstruction.
COUNT exhaustion stops wake-ups but does not materialize lifecycle state or cleanup.
Without durable receipts, a second run cannot infer its ordinal from chat memory.
A projected terminal disposition is not a durable terminal state.
Creating a task from a normal chat does not by itself prove a non-Work execution context.
Future experiment branches are allocated per role, not per worker.
retrialForbiddenUntil: A supported provider can execute and validate the canonical planner.
The same provider can apply a branch-confined mutation with expected-head semantics.
Aggregate ref, commit, changed-path and content readback is proven.
The task creation surface can confirm the requested execution context or fails closed.
